propositions: When close-gate verification fails due to evidence-search budget exhaustion without refuting any criterion, the gate should automatically re-run verification instead of surfacing the failure to the operator.

Auto-resume qualification must use the existing _insufficiency_only predicate to detect when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker, with no schema or prompt changes.
Resumptions are bounded by verify.auto_resume_max count (default 2, configurable to 0 to disable) and must stop early if a re-run produces zero progress (no increase in cache-credited PASS count).
Each auto-resume attempt must be logged with attempt number, cache-credited PASS count, and remaining unmet count, visible in the ticket trail and close output.
The resumption loop must sit at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping llm.verify_completion) so that CLI, MCP, and library close paths all exercise it uniformly.
